messages:
Ivy (Product): Ok team — last call before we freeze pilot scope. Customers want: exportable audit bundles, BYOK for exports, deterministic sampling, and a simple cost estimate in Console.
Ben (Security): Key points: classify events (auth/keystore/full), redactable fields (PII), and sampling reproducibility. Recommend hash-seed sampling + record of seed per-time-window.
Rosa (Eng-Infra): Agreed. Implementation plan: tenant.audit_policy with fields: auth:full, safety:sample:5%, tokens:sample:2%, redact:[user_email]. Sampling via fn(hash(request_id, seed)) % 100 < pct.
Diego (Solutions): Sales needs a short demo: provision BYOK -> set retention lane -> run export -> verify bundle signature. Also include a "what we redact" appendix for auditors.
Maya (Legal): Contract notes: default 90 days, optional pay-for archive, clear language on deterministic sampling and redaction. Add clause about key-rotation notification window (7 days).
ExportAgent: TASK-33445 created: "bundle-spec-and-console-cost-estimator" assigned to @Rosa.
Ben (Security): For integrity choose ED25519 for signatures and SHA-256 checksums. For legacy compatibility we can support RSA-PSS signatures on demand.
Rosa (Eng-Infra): Draft manifest example (compact):
```
manifest_version: "1"
tenant: "global-banking"
time_window: "2026-07-01T00:00Z/2026-07-02T00:00Z"
sampling_seed: "seed-20260701"
audit_policy: "auth:full,safety:5%,tokens:2%"
redact: ["user_email"]
wrapped_export_key: "base64(...)"
files: ["bundle-20260701-0001.ndjson.gz"]
checksums: ["sha256:..."]
signature: "ed25519:..."
```
Diego (Solutions): Also capture a small "replay test": given request_id + seed, we can prove whether a trace was sampled. Add that to the verifier guide.
Ivy (Product): Pilot acceptance checklist proposal: 1) tenant policy API + Console UI, 2) signed export bundle + verifier guide, 3) BYOK export flow + rotation handling doc, 4) Console cost estimator exposed, 5) legal addendum drafted, 6) pilot with 2 regulated customers and auditor review.
Maya (Legal): I'll draft the addendum with sampling disclosure and rotation obligations.
Rosa (Eng-Infra): Quick infra note: need index on tenant+request_id+time for sub-4-hour exports. Without it, cold exports may exceed SLA. Estimate: 2 sprints to add indexing and export worker.
Ben (Security): Action items: I'll write the manifest security spec.
Diego (Solutions): I'll draft demo script + onboarding checklist.
Ivy (Product): We'll reconvene Friday. If you hit blockers earlier, flag here and tag me.
